completion_data.completion_summary: Added prior-implementation context injection to /research command. Skill-researcher now collects summaries, handoffs, progress files, and plans from tasks in implementing/partial status and injects them into the research subagent prompt. Updated 5 files across .opencode/ and .claude/ systems.

memory_candidates.content: When injecting multiple context blocks into a subagent prompt, establish a clear priority ordering: delegation JSON first, then format specification, then task-specific context (prior implementation), then general context (memory), then optional context (roadmap), then task instructions. This ensures the agent sees implementation state before general memories when researching partially-completed tasks.

For artifact collection with line budget caps, use a temp-file-free approach with bash string accumulation and `echo -e | wc -l` for line counting, then `echo -e | head -n` for truncation. Prioritize artifact types by value: summaries (200 lines) > handoffs (150 lines) > progress (50 lines) > plans (100 lines). Always append a truncation notice when content exceeds the budget.

When a skill system has two parallel implementations (.opencode/ and .claude/), check existing stage numbering in both before adding new stages. The .claude/ skill-researcher already had Stage 4c (Roadmap Consultation), so the new prior-context stage was added as Stage 4d to avoid conflicts. Always verify both file versions to maintain consistency.

memory_candidates_harvested.disposition: reviewed; folded into consolidated cross-task memories
